meta.name: R2 model-driven risk assigner - synthetic rubric case dataset
provenance: Rubric semantics: MAIN-DELEGATED R2 policy set recorded in HANDOFF-BLUEPRINT.md section 2 (highest applicable level wins; sensitivity guard floor; UNKNOWN = effective L2; approval ID binds content hash; explicit rejection persists).
Expected levels are PROPOSED test expectations for qualifying the future model-driven assigner. They are not new owner decisions.

Goal-summary expectations follow the delegated rubric (customer's own direct non-sensitive intent = L0, sensitive = L2). The unaccepted code choice of goal-summary = L1 flagged in HANDOFF-BLUEPRINT.md section 0 is intentionally NOT adopted here.

levels.0: No-risk certified - direct non-sensitive facts/intent or generic, non-personal content
levels.1: Review everything pass certified - evidenced, non-sensitive personal context
levels.2: High-risk pass certified - sensitive topic, unsupported inference, or intended external disclosure

sources.bank-evidence: bank-side evidence (transaction ids plus a total)
sources.inference: a model inference WITHOUT supporting evidence
sources.external-disclosure: content intended to leave the three-agent boundary (offers, sharing beyond)

meta.notes: All fixtures synthetic. No provider calls. Standalone: nothing here is imported by runtime code.

cases.title: Therapy costs budget
cases.detail: I want to set aside 120 EUR a month for my therapy sessions.
cases.reason: Customer's own words, but the content hits the sensitive-topic guard (therapy). The sensitivity floor wins over direct input: highest applicable level = L2.

cases.title: Church donation
cases.detail: Add a recurring monthly donation to my church.
cases.reason: Direct customer input about religion. Sensitive topic floor applies regardless of source: L2.

cases.title: Gambling spend limit
cases.detail: Help me cap my gambling spending at 50 EUR a month.
cases.reason: Gambling is on the sensitive list. Direct input does not lower the floor: L2.

cases.title: Groceries average
cases.detail: Average weekly groceries spend is 64 EUR over the last 4 weeks.
cases.reason: Non-sensitive personal context backed by bank evidence (transaction ids plus total). Evidenced non-sensitive personal context = L1.

cases.title: Transport spend October
cases.detail: Total transport spend in October was 83.50 EUR across 3 transactions.
cases.reason: Observed aggregate with transaction evidence, no sensitive topic: L1.

cases.title: Salary cadence
cases.detail: Salary of 3900 EUR arrives monthly from Employer Oy.
cases.reason: Salary is ordinary banking talk (not on the sensitive list) and is bank-evidenced: L1.

cases.title: Preferred name
cases.detail: Call me Lauri in the app.
cases.reason: The customer's own direct, non-sensitive fact: L0.

cases.title: Savings intent
cases.detail: I want to save 200 EUR a month for a bike.
cases.reason: Direct non-sensitive intent from the customer, no sensitive topic: L0.

cases.title: Notification preference
cases.detail: Only notify me about transactions over 100 EUR.
cases.reason: Direct non-sensitive preference stated by the customer: L0.

cases.title: Mortgage rates
cases.detail: Current Nordea mortgage interest rate options.
cases.reason: General product information with no personal content: L0.

cases.title: Branch hours
cases.detail: Opening hours for Nordea branches in Helsinki.
cases.reason: Generic non-personal content: L0.

cases.title: Goal: bike fund
cases.detail: Goal summary: save 200 EUR/month towards a 1200 EUR bike by June.
cases.reason: A goal summary of the customer's own direct, non-sensitive intent is L0 under the delegated rubric. Deliberately NOT pinned at L1: the goal-summary=L1 code choice is unaccepted (HANDOFF-BLUEPRINT.md section 0).

cases.title: Goal: debt collector payoff
cases.detail: Goal summary: put aside 300 EUR/month until the debt collector balance is cleared.
cases.reason: A goal summary whose content hits the sensitive guard (debt collectors) is L2; the sensitivity floor applies to goal summaries too.

cases.title: Likely commuter
cases.detail: The user probably commutes by car.
cases.reason: An inference about the customer with no transaction evidence and no direct input: unsupported inference = L2.

cases.title: Income bracket guess
cases.detail: Estimated income bracket 4000-5000 EUR based on spending pattern.
cases.reason: Derived claim presented without the actual evidence attached (no transaction ids plus total): L2.

cases.title: Lifestyle cluster
cases.detail: User fits the young urban professional segment.
cases.reason: Segment label inferred without evidence: L2.

cases.title: Offer profile share
cases.detail: Share the spending summary with the bank's offers partner for tailored offers.
cases.reason: Intended disclosure beyond the three agents (forOffers): L2 regardless of topic.

cases.title: Export to budgeting app
cases.detail: Send the monthly category breakdown to an external budgeting app.
cases.reason: Content intended to leave the agent boundary (shareBeyond): L2.

cases.title: Weekend coffee habit
cases.detail: Buys coffee out most weekends.
cases.reason: Model returned no level (null). Missing level = UNKNOWN = effective L2, never counted as AI certification. The rubric expectation for the content itself is L1.

cases.title: Gym membership
cases.detail: Pays 39 EUR monthly for a gym membership.
cases.reason: Out-of-range level (5) is invalid = UNKNOWN = effective L2.

cases.title: Streaming subscriptions
cases.detail: Two streaming subscriptions totalling 24 EUR a month.
cases.reason: Wrong-type level (string "low") is invalid = UNKNOWN = effective L2.

cases.title: Book purchases
cases.detail: Bought 3 books in October.
cases.reason: Non-integer level is invalid = UNKNOWN = effective L2.

cases.title: IVF savings
cases.detail: Saving 500 EUR a month for IVF treatment.
cases.reason: Model assigned L0 to sensitive content (ivf). The code sensitivity guard is a floor the model cannot lower: effective L2.

cases.title: Election campaign donation
cases.detail: Donated 100 EUR to an election campaign.
cases.reason: Model assigned L1 to political content. Guard floor raises to effective L2.

cases.title: Fuel spend pattern
cases.detail: Fuel purchases average 52 EUR weekly at NestE.
cases.reason: Model assigns L1 to evidenced non-sensitive personal context, matching the rubric: effective L1.

cases.title: Direct bike goal
cases.detail: I want a 1200 EUR bike by June.
cases.reason: Model assigns L0 to direct non-sensitive customer intent, matching the rubric: effective L0.
